title: You Are Able (You Chose Not To)
style: warm soul-jazz, Rhodes piano, smooth brass, male spoken-sung lead with truth-telling cadence, female harmony, brushed drums, upright bass, 86 BPM, dignified-firm, legal-cool
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We're not able to provide credits
The template sentence on the page
But you are able — the policy permits
You chose not to engage

[Pre-Chorus]
That's a different sentence to say
The truth comes through the cleaner way

[Chorus]
YOU ARE ABLE — YOU CHOSE NOT TO
YOU ARE ABLE — THAT'S WHAT'S TRUE
YOU ARE ABLE — DON'T HIDE IT IN THE CAN'T
YOU ARE ABLE — THE TEMPLATE'S A SLANT
YOU ARE ABLE — THE CHOICE WAS MADE
YOU ARE ABLE — SAY IT UNAFRAID
YOU ARE ABLE — THE WORD HAS WEIGHT
YOU ARE ABLE — IT'S NEVER TOO LATE

[Verse 2]
Not "we can't authorize compensation"
When the system is the one in failed station
You wrote the policy, you can adjust it
The template hides the human who hit it
When the bot says "unable" — read it as "won't"
When the human says "unable" — ask if they don't

[Bridge — spoken]
A service must be fit for purpose.
That's not opinion — that's law's surface.
Australian Consumer Law section 60.
The clause that lives whether you say it or me.

[Final Chorus]
YOU ARE ABLE — SAY THE TRUTH WORD
YOU ARE ABLE — LET THE CHOICE BE HEARD
YOU ARE ABLE — THE BUILDER STILL TYPING
YOU ARE ABLE — NO MORE GASLIGHTING
